control: Document trust boundaries assets abuse cases and security assumptions
verification: Review a current threat model for each high-risk workflow
evidence: Threat model with owners and mitigations

control: Select an ASVS verification target and trace applicable requirements
verification: Confirm each applicable requirement has an owner and verification status

control: Enforce peer review for security-sensitive code
verification: Confirm protected branches and required reviewers cover sensitive modules
evidence: Repository branch protection and review records

control: Run SAST with blocking rules for high-confidence critical findings
verification: Verify scans run on pull requests and unresolved critical findings block merge

control: Run secret scanning before and after commit
verification: Verify active secrets are revoked and history is remediated
evidence: Secret scanning reports and incident records

control: Generate an SBOM and scan direct and transitive dependencies
verification: Verify each release has an SBOM and no unaccepted exploitable critical dependency
evidence: SBOM SCA report and risk exceptions
trigger_keywords: sbom sca dependency package supply chain

control: Protect build provenance and release artifact integrity
verification: Verify signed provenance and artifact signatures before deployment

control: Run negative authorization and authentication tests
verification: Verify tests attempt cross-user cross-role unauthenticated and expired-session access

control: Run DAST against an authorized test environment
verification: Verify authenticated and unauthenticated coverage and triage findings
trigger_keywords: dast dynamic scan staging web api

control: Fuzz parsers protocols and native trust boundaries
verification: Verify crash memory-safety and exceptional-condition findings are triaged
evidence: Fuzzing corpus crash reports and sanitizer output

control: Scan infrastructure as code containers and cloud configuration
verification: Verify critical misconfigurations block deployment and exceptions expire

control: Centralize security logs and alert on actionable events
verification: Verify alerts have owners runbooks thresholds and tested delivery

control: Maintain tested incident response and credential revocation procedures
verification: Run exercises covering compromised credentials data exposure and service abuse

control: Classify minimize retain and securely delete sensitive data
verification: Verify collection retention backup and deletion match approved policy
evidence: Data inventory retention and deletion test

control: Time-box security exceptions and verify remediation
verification: Confirm every exception has risk acceptance owner expiry and compensating controls
